overview.about: The LIV Golf Team Championship is the season-ending finale in which the league's 13 teams go head-to-head in a knockout match-play and stroke-play format for the biggest team prize in the sport. This edition is played at The Cardinal at Saint John's Resort near Detroit.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf Team Championship pits the 13 franchises against each other over a multi-day, bracket-style team event, rather than the usual individual-plus-team format. The season's standings set the seeding and the matchups.
